This update is notable for adding the Entity System. This update was also given the name '''Entity System Update''', as it added the Entity System. This version encompassed twelve updates, the main v1.1.0 update (released 12 March 2022) and eleven minor updates, the v1.1.0a (released the same day as v1.1.0, 12 March 2022), v1.1.0b (released 13
